experiment: P3o-S oracle MFT subtraction causal diagnosis
research_question: On fresh identity-paired compound I/Q, is MFT structure a causal source of ISRJ false positives for the frozen main classifier?
single_changed_axis: The frozen main classifier receives raw compound I/Q (C0), compound I/Q minus the exact power-calibrated MFT component (C1), or compound I/Q minus an equal-energy deterministic non-MFT phase-scrambled control (C2).

conditions.C1_exact_mft_subtraction: subtract exact MFT waveform reconstructed from delay_01..08 and amplitude_01..08, then scale to 10^((10log10(noise_power)+MFT.JNR_dB)/20), then apply the unchanged per-view RMS normalization
conditions.C2_energy_matched_non_mft_control: subtract a deterministic FFT-phase-scrambled version of the same exact scaled MFT waveform; its per-sample energy equals C1's subtracted waveform

data.roles: two independent train-free diagnostic identity sets; no fit, early-stop, calibration, selection or test role
data.identity_rule: zero overlap between the two new seeds and every prior identity file; power and regime views must retain the exact same identities and labels
data.storage_status: not_authorized_for_generation: D: has insufficient capacity; C: output root requires explicit user approval

metrics.primary: ISRJ FPR on source subset MFT=1 and ISRJ=0, per regime-power cell and worst source cell
metrics.inference: paired receiver_noise_seed bootstrap, 2000 resamples, reporting C0-C1 and C2-C1 FPR reductions

decision_rule.pass: Only a pass establishes that exact MFT structure, rather than arbitrary equal-energy removal, is a causal source of the frozen classifier's ISRJ false positives. The result remains a non-deployable oracle diagnosis.
decision_rule.fail: If C1 fails any gate or does not beat C2, do not develop a support-aware MFT subtractor for this Level-4 claim; do not tune C1/C2, thresholds or the frozen classifier on these identities.
